profile.headline: Data Analyst & Engineer | 5+ Years of SaaS Tech Experience | TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Excel,  SQL, React.JS
profile.summary:
I take pride in the fact that my pursuit of excellence has shaped my career.

Over the 5+ years I spent with Eaze, I advanced from a Customer Service Agent to a custom role of Quality Improvement Specialist, designed specifically for my diverse skill set. One of my first projects was creating an Excel-based calculator for product-related taxes, which the company relied on throughout my tenure.

Some of my achievements at Eaze include:

Conducted daily fraud analysis on ~$80k in sales and product-return data, working with the Trust and Safety team to identify and investigate potential fraudulent activity.
Developed and maintained a custom Zendesk email tagging system, as well as a handbook wiki for CS agents, ensuring consistency in responses and improving KPIs.
Created and implemented processes for monthly audits of product and customer service issues, designed database schemas to track product issues, and generated brand-specific reports to highlight trending issues.
Documented and trained new agents on all processes, ensuring seamless onboarding and ongoing efficiency.

Recently, during my internship at Bitly, I expanded my technical skills as a Frontend Engineer. I collaborated with the development team to design and implement front-end solutions, contributed to internal tool redesigns during Hackweek, and ensured high-quality code through thorough testing and debugging.

Currently, as a Remote Frontend Engineer at CondoSites, I focus on developing and maintaining high-quality web applications. I work closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, enhance system reliability, and implement automated testing processes to improve product quality.

I thrive on tackling challenges and learning new skills. If your team needs someone ready to learn and eager to succeed, please reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
HTML, CSS, Javascript, Python

As the sole software engineer on the team, I design and implement technical solutions while also leading data analysis efforts. I am responsible for analyzing client portfolios to extract insights, identifying and resolving issues through research and problem-solving, and delivering actionable recommendations that support business strategy and client success. My role bridges software development and data analytics, ensuring both innovative solutions and data-driven decision making.

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
HTML, CSS, Javascript, PHP
-Developed and maintained responsive web applications, focusing on performance, scalability, and user experience.
-Integrated PHP-based back-end services with front-end components to ensure seamless data flow and functionality.
-Collaborated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, contributing to codebase stability.
-Spearheaded the creation and maintenance of the testing suites utilize Playwright

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the development team to design and implement front-end solutions for our software products.
- Wrote clean, efficient, and maintainable code using industry best practices.
- Worked closely with product managers and designers to understand project requirements and translate them into functional user interfaces.
- Conducted thorough testing and debugging to ensure high-quality and bug-free code.
- Continuously learned and improved my skills in front-end development and stayed updated on emerging technologies and industry trends.
- Participated in code reviews and provided constructive feedback to fellow team members.
- Proactively identified and troubleshot any technical issues that arose during development.
- Communicated effectively with team members and stakeholders to provide status updates and discuss potential roadblocks.
- Participated in Hackweek, helping to redesign internal tools to assist the Customer Service team.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
- Assessed and verified the accuracy and validity of incoming bug reports. Identified the source of issues and produced comprehensive reports to facilitate resolution by the engineering team.
- Designed and executed data reporting and analysis strategies for ~$100,000 in daily sales, utilizing data visualization with SQL, Excel, and Google Sheets to drive informed product decisions.
- Managed patient care-related communications, including emails, phone calls, and other social media inquiries, ensuring HIPAA compliance for medical deliveries, and maintaining a customer satisfaction rating exceeding 98%.
- Assisted in ensuring the accuracy of all customer case records in the CRM system, including the timely resolution of all cases.
- Led internal and external investigations and audits to identify and document evidence of potential fraud, abuse, or criminal activity, implementing strategic changes and methodologies to enhance the organization's future incident response capabilities.
- Conducted thorough research and analysis of product sales and customer account data, developing a dashboard to track, visualize, and report on key trends and anomalies.
- Overhauled all standard operating procedures (SOP) documentation, and establishing an internal wiki tool for centralized access to information, with monthly audits to ensure relevance and accuracy.
- Developed monthly presentations for the Finance team, detailing customer service expenses and the budget control strategies employed by my team to ensure fiscal responsibility and efficiency.
- Established a tagging system for inbound inquiries and issues to quantify business breakdowns, enabling detailed reporting on resolution-related expenses for use in post-mortem analysis meetings.
- Formulated detailed business cases and proposals, providing key analyses and strategies for management consideration.
- Coordinated the recruitment, training, and onboarding of new Quality Improvement team members.
positions.insights: Ad Hoc Analysis, Spreadsheets and +9 skills

projects.title: MeetPup
projects.description:
A Meet-UP clone for dogs. Sequelize + Express backend and React/Redux frontend. It was inspired by silly ideas I wanted to do for my pup Beau. This was the first full-stack project I completed

Code: https://github.com/BigDogEnergy/meetpup
Live Site: https://meetpup.onrender.com

projects.title: Petsy
projects.description:
An Etsy-clone themed towards pets and the art that they make for their audience (owners). This was a Flask backend and React/Redux frontend. I worked on this project with 2 other developers and it came out really cute.

Code: https://github.com/samanarana/Petsy
Live: https://petsy-5c0d.onrender.com/
